notes: «كلهم عن ابن عيينة» makes the three one level of co-transmitters (rule 2)
«قال يحيى أخبرنا سفيان بن عيينة» is the same man in fuller form, written once (rule 7)
«عن أبيه» names no one: relation; the Companion is not named in the text
the dashes and «رضى الله عنه» are glosses and a blessing: left out
